newsitem.title: USA: Pulitzer votes stock dividend, hikes payout.
newsitem.headline: Pulitzer votes stock dividend, hikes payout.

text.p: Pulitzer Publishing Co said Thursday its board declared a four-for-three stock split in the form of a 33.3 percent special stock dividend on its common stock and Class B common.
It also increased the quarterly cash dividend on its common stock and class B common by 6.7 percent to $0.12 per share from $0.1125 per share, adjusted for the stock dividend.
This is the first time Pulitzer has increased its cash dividend twice in one calendar year. Previously, in January, the board boosted the cash dividend by 11.1 percent.
Following the stock dividend, the company will have about 6.4 million shares of publicly traded common stock and 15.6 million shares of Class B common stock outstanding.

The stock dividend and cash dividend are payable on November 1 to holders of record on October 10. The cash dividend will be paid on the increased number of shares resulting from the special stock dividend.
